findings.source: apps/web/src/app/App.tsx:287-336 (fetchNodes), 428-437 (5s interval); same pattern in fetchRuns/fetchApprovals/fetchWorkspaces
findings.claim: Background polling without an in-flight guard or request timeout starves under slow or hung responses: each new 5s poll increments nodeRequest, so the previous request's success or failure is always discarded, and with isBackground the state never leaves 'success'. The M2 'refresh failed silently rendered normal 0' failure therefore remains under latency >5s.
findings.counterexample: Probe P6: observed 0 nodes at t0, then every /nodes answer takes 6s and contains 1 node. After 60s: 13 calls, new node never shown, no cluster-stale-warning, '정상 조회 결과: 0대' still shown. Probe P7: every request hangs and is rejected 60s later (nginx proxy_read_timeout shape): no stale banner, the error is never shown, '정상 조회 결과: 0대' still shown. On base 5368 both reports have stillClaimsCurrentZero=false.
findings.minimalFix: Per resource, skip a background tick while that resource's previous request is still in flight (inFlightRef set before the request and cleared in finally, only for the same request id), so the outstanding success/error is applied. Bound each poll with AbortSignal.timeout(< interval or a documented bound) mapped to the error path, and/or treat lastFetchedAt older than N intervals as stale in ClusterOverview. Add App-level tests in the P6/P7 shape.
findings.regression: Behavioural change in this scenario versus base (base showed the loading/metrics fall-through, not the current-success sentence); the latest-wins starvation itself predates the delta.

findings.claim: Failure label collapse: network error, HTML 200 SPA fallback, JSON 404/503 and JSON status!=ok all render 'Gateway: Offline'. A reachable portal with a mis-routed or unhealthy health endpoint is reported as an unreachable gateway.
findings.counterexample: Probe H1 on 854: html200/json404/json503/jsonStatusDown/network all give offline=true; no distinct label.
findings.minimalFix: Keep online only for JSON status ok. Add a reachable-error state (for example '응답 오류 (HTTP 404)' or '비정상 응답') for any received HTTP response that fails the contract, and keep 'Offline' only for fetch rejection or timeout. Add Header tests per class.

findings.claim: Gateway checks have no request sequence fence and no timeout: overlapping checks are not ordered, so an older slow success can overwrite a newer failure and show an RTT that was not the latest observation; a hung check leaves '확인 중...' or the last state unchanged.
findings.counterexample: Probe H2: check 1 pending, check 2 rejects at 5s -> Offline; check 1 then resolves JSON ok -> Gateway shows Nms online. Present on base 5368 too (pre-existing).
findings.minimalFix: Sequence counter (apply only the latest check) plus AbortSignal.timeout below the 5s interval mapped to Offline.

findings.claim: The click MouseEvent is passed as the new positional isBackground parameter (truthy), so the explicit nodes retry button in the Web Desktop resource explorer runs as a background poll: it does not show loading or clear the prior error until the result.
findings.counterexample: Static: fetchNodes(isBackground = false) receives the event object from onClick={onRetryNodes}; `if (!isBackground)` is false.
findings.minimalFix: Pass `onRetryNodes={() => fetchNodes(false)}` (or test `isBackground === true` inside fetch*).

findings.minimalFix: Add App-level tests with fake timers and mocked apiClient (see reviewer probe P1-P7 shapes) plus an approve/reject click test with approvalsState=error that asserts no decision call.
